newsitem.title: USA: Intel rises to 83 in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Intel rises to 83 in after-hours trade.

text.p: Intel Corp added more than two points in after-hours trade on Tuesday, surging to 83 from an unofficial close of 80-29/32 on better-than-expected second quarter earnings released after the close of regular trade.

The technology company's shares gained more than half a point shortly after it released quarterly earnings of $0.92 per share, which was $0.02 above analysts' expectations, and its stock price continued to climb in after hours trade.
Intel is the world's largest semiconductor manufacturer.
